newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PRIME MINISTER DISMISSES HEAD OF CUSTOMS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PRIME MINISTER DISMISSES HEAD OF CUSTOMS.

text.p: Poland's prime minister accepted on Monday the resignation of the country's head of customs Mieczyslaw Nogaj, the government's press office said in a statement.
The prime minister temporarily appointed for the post the current deputy head of customs Tomasz Cecelski, the statement said. It gave no reasons for the dismissal.
